statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is ordered for further diagnostic evaluation
The patient has associated patient-reported symptoms of dizziness (R42)
The service is distinct and medically necessary to identify intermittent rhythm abnormalities
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
